name: 15213 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15213 (Pittsburgh) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 94 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15213 (Pittsburgh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15213 (Pittsburgh) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
